// Template for mods generated by the EFT Mod Builder (Unity: Custom Windows > EFT Mod Builder).
// The builder copies this DLL and replaces the fixed-length placeholder "EFTAutoMod_ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ"
// (assembly + namespace) with a per-mod unique value, because SPT loads every mod into one AssemblyLoadContext
// (duplicate assembly names fail) and SPTarkov.DI de-duplicates [Injectable] types by "Namespace.Name".
// Everything else (guid, name, author, versions) is read at runtime from modinfo.json next to the DLL.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using SPTarkov.DI.Annotations;
using SPTarkov.Server.Core.DI;
using SPTarkov.Server.Core.Models.Spt.Mod;
using Range = SemanticVersioning.Range;
using Version = SemanticVersioning.Version;

namespace EFTAutoMod_ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ;

internal static class ModInfo
{
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> Values = Load();

    private static Dictionary<string, string> Load()
    {
        var result = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        try
        {
            string? dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(typeof(ModInfo).Assembly.Location);
            if (dir == null) return result;
            string file = Path.Combine(dir, "modinfo.json");
            if (!File.Exists(file)) return result;
            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(file));
            foreach (var p in doc.RootElement.EnumerateObject())
                if (p.Value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                    result[p.Name] = p.Value.GetString() ?? "";
        }
        catch
        {
            // fall through to defaults; SPT reports missing ModGuid/Name/Author/License itself
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static string Get(string key, string fallback)
        => Values.TryGetValue(key, out var v) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v) ? v : fallback;

    public static string? GetOrNull(string key)
        => Values.TryGetValue(key, out var v) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v) ? v : null;
}

public record ModMetadata : IModMetadata
{
    public string ModGuid { get; init; } = ModInfo.Get("guid", "");
    public string Name { get; init; } = ModInfo.Get("name", "");
    public string Author { get; init; } = ModInfo.Get("author", "");
    public List<string>? Contributors { get; init; }
    public Version Version { get; init; } = new Version(ModInfo.Get("version", "1.0.0"));
    public Range SptVersion { get; init; } = new Range(ModInfo.Get("sptVersion", "~4.1.0"));
    public bool HasPrepatcher { get; init; }
    public List<string>? Incompatibilities { get; init; }
    public Dictionary<string, Range>? ModDependencies { get; init; } = new()
    {
        { "com.wtt.commonlib", new Range(ModInfo.Get("wttVersion", "~3.0.3")) }
    };
    public string? Url { get; init; } = ModInfo.GetOrNull("url");
    public string License { get; init; } = ModInfo.Get("license", "NCSA");
}

// Same registration as a working hand-made clothing mod (RCTA.Peely): Transient, TypePriority 100002.
[Injectable(InjectionType.Transient, int.MaxValue, TypePriority = 100002)]
public class AutoMod(WTTServerCommonLib.WTTServerCommonLib wtt) : IOnLoad
{
    public async Task OnLoadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        Assembly assembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
        string root = Path.GetDirectoryName(assembly.Location) ?? "";
        if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(root, "db", "CustomClothing")))
            await wtt.CustomClothingService.CreateCustomClothing(assembly);
        if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(root, "db", "CustomHeads")))
            await wtt.CustomHeadService.CreateCustomHeads(assembly);
    }
}
